answer: Per-action decay inlet: each identity's influence is an exponentially decaying budget replenished only by verified work, with a crystal threshold before actions count. New identities start below it, so a sybil must fund real verified work per identity before any influence registers, and every action burns budget that only slow, costly work refills. An attacker pays compute and time per fake identity, and the jetty of marginal return shrinks as they scale.
